description.en: Clickable HTML prototype canvas for DeepSeek Harness. Chat describes a screen; design_* tools write HTML under .dsh-design/; Prototype preview is a scaled artboard with zoom, pan, pins, and a prototype list.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可点击 HTML 原型画布。聊天描述界面后，design_* 工具把 HTML 写到 .dsh-design/；原型预览按平台尺寸缩放，支持缩放、平移、批注和多份原型切换。
